description: This file contains the implementation of an Android Fragment (CameraFragment) that manages camera operations such as switching between cameras, starting/stopping preview, and handling camera lifecycle. It also includes an inner class 'Preview' that wraps a SurfaceView to display the camera preview with aspect ratio adjustments.

classes.name: CameraFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages camera lifecycle, switching cameras, and embeds a Preview view for live camera feed.

classes.name: Preview
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that contains a SurfaceView to display the camera preview, managing surface lifecycle, aspect ratio, and camera parameter configuration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes camera info and determines default or rear-facing camera; creates preview container.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Returns the Preview view to be displayed.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Opens the camera and starts preview.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases camera resources when fragment is paused.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates camera switch menu if multiple cameras are available.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles switch camera action and navigation.
